description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the LeaveEntitlement entity in the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes setup, test methods, and data providers to verify the behavior of the LeaveEntitlement entity.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the LeaveEntitlement entity, including setup and data provider for testing leave entitlement calculations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating the LeaveEntitlement table before each test.

methods.name: testLeaveEntitlement
methods.description: Tests the calculation and retrieval of the number of days for leave entitlement, using various data inputs.

methods.name: leaveEntitlementDataProvider
methods.description: Provides different test cases with input entitlement values and expected results for testing leave entitlement logic.
